objective: Contener exclusivamente errores opacos cross-origin del runtime Preview que llegan como 'Script error.' sin filename ni Error object y disparan el overlay de React, preservando todos los errores first-party. Mantener emergent-main.js y PostHog intactos. No eliminar dependencias de Emergent, no ocultar errores de la aplicacion, no tocar Produccion. Validar frontend_build real.

actions.new:
<script>
            // EDARSAHUB runtime guard: only contains known browser/platform noise.
            // First-party application errors are never swallowed.
            window.addEventListener("error", function (event) {
                var isKnownPerformanceCloneError =
                    event.error instanceof DOMException &&
                    event.error.name === "DataCloneError" &&
                    event.message &&
                    event.message.includes("PerformanceServerTiming");

                var isOpaqueCrossOriginScriptError =
                    event.message === "Script error." &&
                    !event.filename &&
                    (event.error === null || event.error === undefined);

                if (isKnownPerformanceCloneError || isOpaqueCrossOriginScriptError) {
                    if (isOpaqueCrossOriginScriptError && window.console && console.warn) {
                        console.warn("[EDARSAHUB_RUNTIME_GUARD] Opaque cross-origin script error contained");
                    }
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    event.preventDefault();
                }
            }, true);
        </script>
